metadata.name: GetMerchantReserveParameters
metadata.description: This API is used to get the Merchant Reserve Parameters.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: MerchantID
request_fields.description: Unique number of merchant account Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXX Example:12345 Condition: Mandatory If MerchantNumber not Inputted in API Request

request_fields.name: MerchantNumber
request_fields.description: Merchant Number which is assgined to a Merchant Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXX Example:12345 Condition: Mandatory If MerchantID not Inputted in API Request Allowable Values: 10

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10

children.name: AddPastDue90ToReserve
children.description: Determines Past Due 90 to be Added to the Merchant Reserve or Not Valid Values: '0' = Yes and '1' = No Format: X Example: 0

children.name: PastDue
children.description: Determines if the Past Due is on Amount or on Balance Amount = Reserve Calculation will be Done on 3 cycle (to 7 cycle past due) past due amount Balance = Reserve calculation on Current Balance Valid Values: Amount = '1', Balance = '0' Format: X Example: 0 Condition: Functional only if 'AddPastDue90ToReserve' is set to 'Yes'

children.name: AddUnmailedtoReserve
children.description: if Set as Yes then Reserve Calculations will be done for the Accounts with statuses as set in the fields 'IncludedAccountStatus1,2,3, 4 and 5', depending the same statuses must be set on Merchant Account Parameters in Fields 'Hold Account Status 1,2,3 and 4' Valid Values: '0' = Yes and '1' = No Format: X Example: 0

children.name: AddCreditBalancestoReserve
children.description: Determines Credit Balances  to be Added to the Merchant Reserve or Not Valid Values: '0' = Yes and '1' = No Format: X Example: 0

children.name: AddnoFinanceChargeAccountstoReserve
children.description: Determines No Finance Charge Accounts to be Added to the Merchant Reserve or Not Valid Values: '0' = Yes and '1' = No Format: X Example: 0

children.name: PercentOfNewBalanceAddToReserve
children.description: Determines percentage of New Balance to be Added to the Merchant Reserve Valid Values:0-9 Format: XX.XX Example: 10.00%

children.name: ReserveTable
children.description: Indicates the Reserve Table Applied on the Merchant

children.name: IncludedAccountStatus1
children.description: Indicates that Account with status will be Included for Reserve Calculations, condition only if the same status is also set in 'HoldAccountStatus' fields in Merchant Account Parameters Valid Values: Status Codes check Appendix
